description: This file implements CLI progress indicator functions, including creating progress reporters, updating progress, and handling terminal output with support for spinners, lines, and logs.

methods.name: createCliProgress
methods.description: Creates a progress reporter object based on provided options, managing terminal output and progress state.

methods.name: withProgress
methods.description: Executes an asynchronous task with a progress reporter, ensuring progress is finalized afterward.

methods.name: withProgressTotals
methods.description: Executes an asynchronous task with progress updates based on total and completed counts.
